title: Leer's first implant removal: T-shaped object in uncuttable tissue

tellings.quote: We found the object uh the first one and we took it out. Uh it looked like nothing that I had ever removed before in a way of a foreign body.

plain: In the 1990s in Thousand Oaks, California, a doctor named Roger Leir says he surgically removed his first suspected alien implant from a patient: a small T-shaped object set in tissue so tough it would barely cut. Leir, who did the surgery himself, tells Michels the object "looked like nothing that I had ever removed before" as a foreign body. If true, it would be physical evidence that something had been placed inside a person.
